aggregate.description: Defines how to perform data aggregation (e.g., maximum, count, minimum) on the retrieved data.

data.description: The details of the aggregate data.

name.description: The name of the query response.

aggregate.title: Aggregate

dest_page.description: Specifies the page number of results to retrieve for pagination.

getDeleted.description: If true, includes deleted URL categories in the results.

group_by.description: A list of fields to group the results by for aggregation purposes.

last_query_ts.description: A timestamp (in milliseconds or seconds since the epoch) that records the time the previous query was executed.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return per page.

next_query.description: Contains the parameters required to execute the next page of the query for pagination.

query_params.description: An object containing specific filter criteria to narrow down the results (e.g., filtering by name or ID).

retrieved_fields.description: A list of specific fields (attributes) you want to be included in the response.

retrieved_fields_mask.description: A flag that determines the meaning/interpretation of the fields listed in the retrieved_fields array.

sort_case_insensitive.description: Specifies whether the sorting operation defined in sort_params should ignore the case of the field values.

sort_params.description: Defines the sorting criteria for the results (e.g., sort by name ascending).

total_count.description: The expected or requested total count of records.

body.description: Details to query the URL Category Information.
